author: ai6yr@m.ai6yr.org
text: Tropical Storm Nolo (soon Hurricane Nolo) Key Messages: 1. Tropical Storm Nolo is expected to strengthen into a hurricane on Thursday as it moves northward, potentially making its closest approach to the Big Island of Hawaii on Saturday. A Hurricane Watch is now in effect for the Big Island, and residents there should follow advice given by local officials, including evacuating if told to do so. 2. The time to prepare for significant heavy rain and flooding impacts on the Big Island is now, as heavy rain becomes more likely by Thursday and Friday. Periods of heavy rain are likely to continue across the Big Island and Maui through the weekend. Life-threatening, catastrophic flooding and mudslides are possible, especially in areas of steep terrain across the Big Island and Maui. Across the remainder of Hawaii, lesser rainfall totals are expected, with isolated flooding possible. 3. Large and damaging waves are possible along the coast of the Big Island into the weekend. 4. Interests elsewhere in Hawaii should closely monitor the latest forecast updates and ensure that they have their preparedness plan in place. https://www.nhc.noaa.gov/text/refresh/HFOTCDCP2+shtml/232056.shtml #Hiwx #hurricanenolo #nolo #hurricane #tropicalwx #elnino
